Not a data leak (fn_current_org NULL hides everything else).

A user whose dashboard module is removed in Staff still sees the KPI tiles (v_home_kpis has no module condition) while the Done action (home-actions.ts:16) is gated on dashboard, so Wall 2 and Wall 3 disagree.

findings.problem: 0003 stops new leaks but does not scrub existing audit_log rows: on onion_crm the audit-module holders (owner, accountant) can still read 18 product_costs snapshots and 2 business_settings snapshots with full bank_details (account_no, ifsc) written before 0003. Both roles can read that data from the live tables anyway, so no new exposure, but the contract statement 'audit_log contains no bank_details or product_costs rows' is false on the current DB. 'bank_details' OR new_data ? 'bank_details');

findings.problem: REVOKEs name PUBLIC and authenticated only. Locally anon has no EXECUTE (verified anon_exec=f), but hosted Supabase default privileges grant EXECUTE on every new public function to anon explicitly and REVOKE FROM PUBLIC does not remove an explicit grant, so fn_next_code, fn_next_doc_no, fn_assign_*, fn_set_user_* (and 0004-0006 functions copying the contracts 2.3 template) become callable by anon on hosted. Each fails on fn_current_org()/fn_require_module for a caller without a profile, but ci:tenant-check check 5 (which includes anon) will go red on the hosted DB. Unverifiable until credentials arrive.
findings.fix: Append ', anon' to each REVOKE in 0003 (role exists locally since 0000 and on Supabase) and change the contracts 2.3 template to REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION fn_x(...) FROM PUBLIC, anon; optionally extend ci-tenant-check to fail when anon can execute any allowlisted SECURITY DEFINER function.

findings.problem: actAs sets only request.jwt.claim.sub, which the local shim auth.uid() reads; Supabase's real auth.uid() reads request.jwt.claims->>'sub'. Against the hosted DB the suite impersonates nobody: 'attack blocked' cases pass vacuously (NULL uid) and 'allowed' cases fail, so a policy regression could hide behind expected failures.
findings.fix: In actAs also run set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', $1, 'role', 'authenticated')::text, false); resetRole already clears both GUCs.

findings.problem: DEMO_PASSWORD='DemoPass123!' and the four demo emails are module-level constants in a client component; NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE only hides the buttons via the demo prop, so the literal ships in /_next/static/chunks/app/login/page.js for every build (confirmed in the current .next output).
